dvids.title: NAVSUP FLC Norfolk Helps Ensure Deployed Sailors' Votes Count
dvids.desc: The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Norfolk Regional Navy Mail Center recently worked to ensure sailors deployed in the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility had their voices heard in this year's elections, coordinating the receipt and processing of their absentee ballots.
